_comment: Vagaro is the single source of truth for the treatment menu: the daily sync
mirrors her live catalogue (categories, services, prices, descriptions).
2026-09-02: every booking row opens the one unscoped widget below. The July
per-category widgets were orphaned by the August catalogue restructure (their
encoded category references died, so they all rendered the default full menu),
and Faisel chose not to re-mint them for now. To bring back category-scoped
booking: mint one widget per category in Vagaro -> Settings -> Booking Widget,
add them under widgets, and map normalized category names to widget keys in
categoryWidgets — the daily sync rolls the links onto every row. Widget URLs
are stateless snapshots: nothing in Vagaro lists or stores them, this file is
